#### Load Functions
```{r}
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

prepare_snp_data <-function(SNP_df) {
  # Copy annotation column 
  SNP_df$ann_rep <- SNP_df$SNV_accession
  # Separate annotation
  SNP_df <- SNP_df |> 
    separate_wider_delim(ann_rep, delim = "|", names = c("acc","type","class","mechanism","group","snp"))
  # Separate snp annotation
  SNP_df <- SNP_df |> 
    separate_wider_delim(snp, delim = "_", names = c("grp_acc","ref_nuc","pos","var_nuc"))
  # Nucleotide to upercase 
  SNP_df$ref_nuc <- toupper(SNP_df$ref_nuc)
  SNP_df$var_nuc <- toupper(SNP_df$var_nuc)
  # Re-make meg ann
  SNP_df <- SNP_df |>
    unite("meg_ann",acc,type,class,mechanism,group, sep = "|", remove = FALSE)
  # Remake SNP ann
  SNP_df <- SNP_df |>
    unite("SNP",grp_acc,ref_nuc,pos,var_nuc,sep="_")
  parsed_SNP_df <- SNP_df |>
    unite("SNP_ann",acc,type,class,mechanism,group,SNP,sep="|")
  return(parsed_SNP_df)
}

get_snp_counts3 <- function(metadata,called_snps,tp1,tp2,snp_accs) {
  nrows <- 10
  final_df <- data.frame(
    SampleID = character(nrows),
    Repeat = character(nrows),
    All_tp_snps = numeric(nrows),
    All_tp_genes = numeric(nrows),
    All_cap_snps = numeric(nrows),
    Cap_tp_genes = numeric(nrows),
    Cap_tp_snps = numeric(nrows),
    TP_less_2 = numeric(nrows),
    TP_3_to_5 = numeric(nrows),
    TP_more_6 = numeric(nrows),
    FP_less_2 = numeric(nrows),
    FP_3_to_5 = numeric(nrows),
    FP_more_6 = numeric(nrows)
  )
  for (i in 1:nrow(metadata)) {
    val1 <- metadata$SampleID[i]
    val2 <- metadata$Repeat[i]
    R_snps <- called_snps[,c("SNV_accession",paste0(val1),"meg_ann","SNP_ann")]
    if (metadata$ARG_set[i] == "Set1") {
      R_tp <- tp1[,c("header","snp_header",paste0(val2))] #filter tp1 for sample
      R_tp_filt <- R_tp |> dplyr::filter(!!sym(val2) == 1) # get tp values for sample
      R_snps_filt <- R_snps |> dplyr::filter(!!sym(val1) >= 1) # get nonzero vals
      R_snps_filt <- R_snps_filt |> dplyr::filter(!meg_ann %in% snp_accs) # remove SNPconf
      R_genes_list <- as.list(R_tp_filt$header)
      R_snps_genefilt <- R_snps_filt |> dplyr::filter(meg_ann %in% R_genes_list)
      tp_snp_list <- as.list(R_tp_filt$snp_header)
      R_snps_snpfilt <- R_snps_genefilt |> dplyr::filter(SNP_ann %in% tp_snp_list)
      FP_snps <- R_snps_filt |> dplyr::filter(!SNP_ann %in% tp_snp_list) # get non-tp SNPs
    } else {
      R_tp <- tp2[,c("header","snp_header",paste0(val2))]
      R_tp_filt <- R_tp |> dplyr::filter(!!sym(val2) == 1)
      R_snps_filt <- R_snps |> dplyr::filter(!!sym(val1) >= 1)
      R_snps_filt <- R_snps_filt |> dplyr::filter(!meg_ann %in% snp_accs)
      R_genes_list <- as.list(R_tp_filt$header)
      R_snps_genefilt <- R_snps_filt |> dplyr::filter(meg_ann %in% R_genes_list)
      tp_snp_list <- as.list(R_tp_filt$snp_header)
      R_snps_snpfilt <- R_snps_genefilt |> dplyr::filter(SNP_ann %in% tp_snp_list)
      FP_snps <- R_snps_filt |> dplyr::filter(!SNP_ann %in% tp_snp_list) # get non-tp SNPs
    }
    All_tp_snps <- nrow(R_tp_filt) # save for metadata
    All_tp_genes <- n_distinct(R_tp_filt$header) # save for metadata
    All_cap_snps <- nrow(R_snps_filt) # save for metadate 
    Cap_tp_genes <- n_distinct(R_snps_genefilt$meg_ann) # Save for metadata
    Cap_tp_snps <- nrow(R_snps_snpfilt) # save for metadata
    TP_less_2 <- nrow(R_snps_snpfilt |> dplyr::filter(!!sym(val1) <= 2))
    TP_3_to_5 <- nrow(R_snps_snpfilt |> dplyr::filter(!!sym(val1) >= 3 & !!sym(val1) <=5))
    TP_more_6 <- nrow(R_snps_snpfilt |> dplyr::filter(!!sym(val1) >= 6))
    FP_less_2 <- nrow(FP_snps |> dplyr::filter(!!sym(val1) <= 2))
    FP_3_to_5 <- nrow(FP_snps |> dplyr::filter(!!sym(val1) >= 3 & !!sym(val1) <=5))
    FP_more_6 <- nrow(FP_snps |> dplyr::filter(!!sym(val1) >= 6))
    final_df[i, ] <- list(val1,val2,All_tp_snps,All_tp_genes,All_cap_snps,Cap_tp_genes,Cap_tp_snps,TP_less_2,TP_3_to_5,TP_more_6,FP_less_2,FP_3_to_5,FP_more_6)
  }
  return(final_df)
}

benchmark_metrics3 <- function(input_df) {
  ## Recall = TP/(TP+FN), FN = All_tp - Cap_tp
  input_df$False_negatives <- input_df$All_tp_snps - input_df$Cap_tp_snps
  input_df$Recall <- input_df$Cap_tp_snps/(input_df$Cap_tp_snps + input_df$False_negatives)
  ## Precision = TP/(TP+FP)
  input_df$False_positives <- input_df$All_cap_snps - input_df$Cap_tp_snps
  input_df$Precision <- input_df$Cap_tp_snps/(input_df$Cap_tp_snps + input_df$False_positives)
  ## F1 = 2(TP)/((2TP)+FP+FN)
  input_df$F1_score <- (2*input_df$Cap_tp_snps) / ((2*input_df$Cap_tp_snps) + input_df$False_positives + input_df$False_negatives)
  ## Widen metadata annotation 
  input_df$Annotation <- input_df$SampleID
  output_df <- input_df |> 
    tidyr::separate_wider_delim(Annotation, delim = "_", names = c("Sample","Depth","Rep","Host_Rep","Aln_len","ANI","DB"))
  
  return(output_df)
}
```

### Load and process data
```{r}
### Other packages
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(ggokabeito)
### Data
tp_data1 <- readRDS("v2_tp_snp_data/set1_v4_R_snp_onebased_pa.rds")
tp_data2 <- readRDS("v2_tp_snp_data/set2_v4_R_snp_onebased_pa.rds")
snp_accs <- readRDS("v2_tp_snp_data/draft2_v4_snpheads.rds")
host_snps_45 <- read.csv("Host_rem_Results/host_rem_ngl_45bp_snv_analytic_matrix.csv")
meta_host_45 <- read.csv("Host_rem_Results/host_metadata_45.csv")
host_snps_75 <- read.csv("Host_rem_Results/host_rem_ngl_75bp_snv_analytic_matrix.csv")
meta_host_75 <- read.csv("Host_rem_Results/host_metadata_75.csv")
host_snps_100 <- read.csv("Host_rem_Results/host_rem_ngl_100bp_snv_analytic_matrix.csv")
meta_host_100 <- read.csv("Host_rem_Results/host_metadata_100.csv")

## Benchmark results
prep_host_45 <- prepare_snp_data(host_snps_45)
snp_host_45 <- get_snp_counts3(meta_host_45,prep_host_45,tp_data1,tp_data2,snp_accs)
prep_host_75 <- prepare_snp_data(host_snps_75)
snp_host_75 <- get_snp_counts3(meta_host_75,prep_host_75,tp_data1,tp_data2,snp_accs)
prep_host_100 <- prepare_snp_data(host_snps_100)
snp_host_100 <- get_snp_counts3(meta_host_100,prep_host_100,tp_data1,tp_data2,snp_accs)
merge_snp_10m <- rbind(snp_host_45,snp_host_75,snp_host_100)
host_snp_out <- benchmark_metrics3(merge_snp_10m)
host_snp_out <- host_snp_out |> mutate(Aln_len = factor(Aln_len, levels = c("45bp","75bp","100bp")))
```

### Make plot data
```{r}
### Recall 
ggplot(host_snp_out, aes(x = Depth, y = Recall, fill = Aln_len))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  xlab("Read depth")+
  ylab("SNV Recall")+
  ggtitle("A")+
  scale_fill_okabe_ito()+
  ylim(c(0,1))+
  theme(legend.position = "None")

### Precision
ggplot(host_snp_out, aes(x = Depth, y = Precision, fill = Aln_len))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  xlab("Read depth")+
  ylab("SNV Precision")+
  ggtitle("B")+
  scale_fill_okabe_ito()+
  ylim(c(0,1))+
  labs(fill = "Minimum\nAlignment\nLength")

### Publication facing stats
mean(host_snp_out$Recall)
sd(host_snp_out$Recall)
mean(host_snp_out$Precision)
sd(host_snp_out$Precision)
```

### Get host removal statistics: 
```{r}
host_rem <- read.table("Host_rem_Results/host.removal.stats", header = TRUE)

# Divide by two, since counts are aggregated across both files, and I want the average of the two
host_rem$NumberOfInputReads <- host_rem$NumberOfInputReads/2
host_rem$Mapped <- host_rem$Mapped/2
host_rem$Unmapped <- host_rem$Unmapped/2
host_rem$Perc_host_rem <- host_rem$Mapped/20000000
mean(host_rem$Perc_host_rem)
sd(host_rem$Perc_host_rem)
```


### Get difference in AMR counts
```{r}
## Raw sample (no host)
raw_amr <- read.csv("Host_rem_Results/AMR_0gf_0qc_analytic_matrix_mock_samples.csv")
raw_df <- as.data.frame(colSums(raw_amr[,2:11]))
raw_df <- rownames_to_column(raw_df, var = "SampleID")
colnames(raw_df) <- c("SampleID","Raw_amr_counts")
raw_df$Type <- "NonHost"
## Host sample 
host_amr <- read.csv("Host_rem_Results/AMR_0gf_0qc_analytic_matrix.csv")
host_df <- as.data.frame(colSums(host_amr[2:11]))
host_df <- rownames_to_column(host_df, var = "HostSampleID")
colnames(host_df) <- c("HostSampleID","Host_amr_counts")
host_df$SampleID <- host_df$HostSampleID
host_df <- host_df |> separate_wider_delim(
  cols = SampleID,
  delim = "_H",
  names = c("SampleID","Hnum")
)
host_df$Hnum <- paste0("H",host_df$Hnum)

amr_count_df <- merge(raw_df, host_df, by = "SampleID")

amr_count_df$Perc_AMR_kept <- amr_count_df$Host_amr_counts / amr_count_df$Raw_amr_counts
mean(amr_count_df$Perc_AMR_kept)
sd(amr_count_df$Perc_AMR_kept)
```
